spec.name: tes
pollInterval
spec.description: Task polling interval duration (for example `5s` or `30s`).

spec.name: timeout
spec.description: TES API timeout in seconds for connect, read, and write operations.

spec.name: tags
spec.description: Arbitrary tags added to TES tasks.
The `tes` scope configures the GA4GH Task Execution Service (TES) executor.
